Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Mormugao Port Authority to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mormugao Port Authority Materials Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Materials Manager post is 06 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Materials Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree or equivalent in Mechanical/Electrical/Production/Industrial Engineering from a recognized University/Institution, along with specific years of service in relevant grades.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Materials Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Materials Manager post will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 80000 to Rs. 220000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Materials Manager post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the Materials Manager post in the Mormugao Port Authority recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Materials Manager post is strictly online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Mormugao Port Authority recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Materials Manager role?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on merit, determined by ACR/APAR grading, which should not be below 'Very Good'.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation.

faq.answer: The official website of Mormugao Port Authority is https://mormugao.gov.in, which can be found in the 'Important Links' section.
